column1: # Every dependency Laplace builds against, declared once (Laplace-Operations#3). setup.ps1 reads it on Windows and
# setup.sh on Linux. A row is pinned by its commit (sources) or the SHA-256 of its archive (releases, tools); a moved
# tag cannot change a build. Sources are fetched into $LAPLACE_DEPSRC/<name>; builds go to $LAPLACE_BUILD/deps/<name>;
# kind      source: Git checkout at the commit. release: upstream archive (binaries, or SQLite's amalgamation). tool: a
# build     how the build part makes it: cmake, configure, meson, openssl, headers, amalgamation (one C file, compiled
#           as a DLL), none (consumed as source by Laplace-Native or the Engine), unpack, sfx (a self-extracting
# profile   icx-deterministic: Laplace-Native's flags (precise FP, no contraction, no fast math), spelled per driver.
#           icx: icx with precise FP (icx defaults to -fp-model=fast; Laplace-Operations#3). none: not compiled here.
# use       who needs it. A row without a consumer does not belong here.
# proof     the file that says the row is installed, relative to its prefix: <deps>/<name>/<version>, the checkout for a row
#           built into Laplace (build none), PostgreSQL's prefix for PostGIS; .pin for an unpacked archive. setup.ps1 builds a row
